Conclusion

I inspected CartmanFatass/My-paper-code at the exact reachable commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81, whose commit message is refactor: restore bounded workflow capabilities, and read all seven named references at that SHA.

No family is a full survivor. A static no-CM stop is justified.

Frozen family	Classification	Decisive reason
Overlapping many-to-one contention	Support-only null	The physical association effect is real and maximal, but the association target and external conditional-Q contrast are the same content sign, producing the same population update.
Serial two-hop complementarity	Support-only null	The additional causal depth establishes an ordered path but supplies no additional decision statistic beyond the same conditional-Q contrast.
Censored substitution chain	Generic-denoising / variance-only null	The pathwise target is heterogeneous, but its conditional mean is exactly 2s/3; Rao–Blackwellization reproduces the population update and removes mode variance.

None is presently an invalid comparison. Withholding the edge object, transformed target, or optimizer geometry from the generic arm in order to obtain a gap would create the invalid comparison.

The correct bounded investment disposition is to close this exact association-specific, exact-population search, record the three constructions as static terminal evidence alongside protected T3 and retained B1, and perform no relay or sampled implementation. Any future work should be a separately named generic approximation-efficiency spin-off, not a continuation or repair of this object.

Comparator overreach

The strongest objection is partly correct but does not rescue the candidate.

Sharing the edge key and any transformed target means the comparison does not test the value of discovering, constructing, or exposing that association object. It tests the narrower question of whether, once the same relation and evidence are available, a specialized association-credit update has irreducible decision value beyond a competent conditional estimator.

That is exactly the question frozen here.

The useful decomposition is:

Association extraction: identify and represent the source–waiter relation.

Target estimation: turn shared evidence into source-record credit.

Optimization: turn the resulting population vector into a policy step.

The parity contract makes layer 1 common and layer 3 common. Only layer 2 is under comparison. Giving the generic arm the public edge key therefore makes it association-aware in representation, but does not by itself make it the specialized credit rule. If the generic estimator then reproduces the same source update, the result is that the specialized rule is unnecessary conditional on the common representation.

Giving the generic arm the exact candidate scalar may appear stronger. But the contract deliberately says that any transformation, routing object, or sufficient statistic consumed by the candidate is also available to the generic arm. Under that containment question, the candidate must demonstrate value beyond its upstream representation and surrogate construction. It does not.

This comparison would be overreaching only if the desired claim were instead:

Is computing or exposing the source–waiter relation useful compared with a learner that never receives it?

That is a representation question, not the registered association-specific credit question.

Biased finite-step coordination does not supply a survivor

A biased relation-indexed surrogate can indeed be noncollinear with the true external-return gradient. On a nonconcave objective, stepping along it can produce higher finite-radius utility than stepping along exact external Q.

But three distinctions matter.

First, if the same biased scalar is available to the generic arm, the conditional-expectation argument reproduces its population score vector exactly. Both arms take the same step and obtain the same utility.

Second, if the generic arm is restricted to true external Q while the candidate alone receives the biased surrogate, a positive result would identify surrogate or optimizer geometry, not association-specific credit. The relevant comparator would be a generic feature- or relation-indexed surrogate using the same object.

Third, in these surfaces a surrogate constructed from the known positive/negative content table risks directly encoding which source action should be preferred. That is task-specific shaping unless derived by a prospectively generic rule. If it is derived by such a rule, the same-object generic arm can apply it.

There is therefore no smallest admissible biased construction satisfying the present contract. Every apparent route requires at least one forbidden asymmetry:

withholding the surrogate or relation object from the generic arm;

allowing candidate-specific curvature, normalization, preconditioning, or trust geometry;

differentiating through a candidate-only target graph;

or hard-coding the external utility table into the candidate.

Without such an asymmetry, the 0.10 allocation and utility gates and the 0.05 native-minus-severed gate cannot be approached: their exact values are zero.

Exact enumeration: useful as proof, redundant as an experiment

Exact finite enumeration is not vacuous for establishing causal support. It can verify that all six ordered assignments are represented, that activation changes the correct physical waiter, that the downstream consequence has the stipulated magnitude, and that severing removes it.

It is, however, scientifically redundant as an executable investment discriminator after the equality premises have been verified. The answer follows analytically from the score-form update and same-object parity. Executing the three enumerations could only do one of two things:

reproduce the registered zeros; or

expose an implementation or construction violation.

The second outcome would not be a positive association result; it would mean the implemented object was not the stipulated finite surface. Thus no exact executable observation is still decision-changing, and no CM implementation is warranted.

This is consistent with the retained B1 logic. B1 deliberately used common-snapshot four-world effects, replaced rather than added the tagged GAE atom, preserved label multisets in the cut, and matched work and update displacement. Its prospective outcome map explicitly treated equal intact/cut behavior as unnecessary binding, common improvement over GAE as generic counterfactual shaping or low-variance credit, and selectivity without utility as no demonstrated task value. The implementation likewise computes the four-world interaction, performs a common normalized full-batch step, matches work, and requires both native utility and native-minus-yoked interaction margins.

The retained result then showed positive selectivity changes but exactly zero intact-minus-GAE native and yoked utility effects and exactly zero Psi_G, with equal work and fixed counts. The technical intake records that these zeros occurred at every root and that no rerun or unchanged-science repair was warranted. The direction’s preserved current position is correspondingly: “Expressibility/selectivity passed, but utility and allocation improvement were zero.”

Canonical minimality and larger family members

A larger member is not scientifically required to interpret these three nulls.

The smallest constructions are not failing because their physical effects are weak:

the uncensored utility swing is the full permitted 0↔1;

both signs are represented;

all six ordered assignments are balanced;

two eligible waiters exist;

the edge key is explicit;

and the serial family already includes a two-hop consequence.

Their failure is at the level of decision sufficiency, not causal support or signal magnitude.

Invoking a larger member after observing exact equality would also violate the prospective smallest-construction law. A larger host could be scientifically different if it introduced constrained computation, imperfect relation inference, simultaneous nonseparable actions, limited model capacity, or multi-update feedback. But those are new scientific objects. Nothing in the present evidence shows that the smallest construction was malformed or underpowered and therefore needs enlargement.

This judgment makes no claim about the result of any larger host.

Exact-estimator strength and shared parameters

The exact generic estimator is strong, but appropriately so for this question. The purpose is to determine whether irreducible population decision content exists before sampled training. A candidate that can win only because a generic critic is imperfect has established an approximation or sample-efficiency advantage, not an exact association-specific value.

Shared parameters do not create a loophole. They can make multiple records interfere after an update, but both arms produce the same complete shared-parameter update vector. The resulting interference is therefore also identical.

The material caveat is that equal first moments need not imply equal behavior under:

samplewise gradient normalization;

arm-local Adam or RMSProp second moments;

target-dependent curvature;

clipping before expectations are aggregated;

stochastic threshold crossing;

or multiple adaptive updates.

The current contract removes these routes by using exact population quantities and a common preconditioner and trust map. If an implementation introduced arm-local target-dependent geometry, the equality lemma would no longer settle that implementation—but the comparison would have changed into an optimizer study.

Censoring and source localization

Censoring does not rescue association-specific value here. It creates uncertainty about how the path completes, but the action-time conditional mean is the sufficient statistic for expected external utility. The candidate’s realized association label is a noisier unbiased representation of that same statistic.

Source localization also remains real but non-discriminating. In all three hosts, the downstream physical consequence belongs causally to the source action through the correct waiter relation. Severing can eliminate that path. Yet the generic conditional Q is evaluated at that same source action and therefore localizes the expected consequence to the same policy score. A severable causal path proves where the effect came from; it does not prove that only the association construction can convert it into the correct decision.

T3 already demonstrated this separation especially cleanly: balanced ordered-waiter support and complete severing sensitivity coexisted with pair-aware GAE/pair-Q collinearity, machine-precision Bellman closure, zero noiseless probability difference, and zero fixed-token allocation and utility gaps. The new topologies alter the physical story but not the missing decision residual.

Strongest evidence against this conclusion

The strongest challenge is that population-gradient equality is not an equivalence theorem for finite-sample, nonlinear, adaptive learning. B1’s proximal selectivity movement and T3’s positive sampled favorable-allocation shift of roughly 2.22×10
−5
 show that tiny sample- or geometry-level discrepancies can occur even when actual allocation and utility do not change.

That evidence is worth preserving. It does not satisfy the present gates:

T3’s actual allocation and utility gaps were exactly zero;

its source-localized excess interval crossed zero;

the sampled probability shift was orders of magnitude below 0.10;

and the current surfaces remove sampling altogether.

The strongest counterargument therefore supports a different finite-approximation question, not continued exact association work.

Common failure risk for finite-host credit research

The recurring risk is to mistake a large, balanced, severable physical association effect for unique learning value.

A finite host can convincingly show that:

source action A changed physical waiter W;

W changed a delayed outcome;

the path vanished under severing;

and an association target moved policy probabilities;

while still failing to show that the target contains anything a same-information conditional estimator could not express. Apparent success can then come from denoising, altered gradient scaling, comparator corruption, arm-specific optimizer geometry, or a tiny probability shift that never changes the scarce decision.

The correct separator is not “does the association exist?” but:

After the relation and evidence are made common, is there a nonzero population decision component that cannot be represented by a competent generic conditional estimator?

For these three constructions, the answer is no.

Investment recommendation

Close the exact scope. Do not implement the three surfaces, add relay, enlarge a family, alter the margins, weaken the generic arm, or reopen T3. Fuse the analytic dispositions with B1 and protected T3 as a terminal bounded record showing:

Strong association support can coexist with zero residual decision value against a same-information generic conditional estimator.

The smallest scientifically distinct reentry is a censored-substitution finite-sample relational-estimation discriminator:

freeze an explicit association-factorized critic and a competent generic edge-conditioned relational critic before data;

match parameters, dataset, trajectories, edge-key access, optimizer state, updates, FLOPs, and memory;

use the same target objects and evaluator;

measure held-out conditional-target error and source-gradient estimation error first;

then measure one frozen scarce allocation and utility update;

and interpret any gain only as representation, denoising, or approximation efficiency.

That reentry would not revisit the exact-population association claim. It would ask whether an explicit relational factorization reaches the already-common conditional target more efficiently under finite resources.

The maximum supported conclusion remains confined to the three stipulated smallest balanced, three-agent, fixed-population, finite-horizon, exact-population, single-update abstract hosts under the stated parity and common-trust contract.
